lines.4: 「Miss Inori, it's unusual to see you at this hour.」
lines.5: 「Erika, that thing of yours is a genuine disease. Very bad.」
lines.6: 「Those without a chest can stay quiet.」
lines.8: 「Actually, why are you named Mr. Tsuchinaga?」
lines.9: 「Inori, give this blonde a quick explanation.」
lines.10: 「One need only look at the parrot's face.」
lines.13: 「I should warn you: I already have a woman I love. No matter how hard you stare, you won't melt me.」
lines.14: 「Let me see... Looking at the shape of his face, does it not somehow sound like 'Mr. Tsuchinaga'?」
lines.15: 「If we're going by how it sounds, he feels more like a 'Mr. Sasayama' to me.」
lines.16: 「I don't understand. I don't understand this conversation at all...」
lines.17: 「That's how it should be. At least Yoshimi and I can remain the common-sense duo and keep things serious.」
